採用・広告の製品.quote: Extrusion without jams or warping. Print without complications, with perfect results from the first layer
Robust and visually clean parts. It combines hardness, functionality and aesthetics. To print on continuous use.
PETG Prototype Winkle Filament
In Winkle we not only sell 3D filament: we manufacture it ourselves in Salamanca, with own and controlled extrusion processes.

Manufacturing your own filament is not just an advantage: it is a declaration of principles. We supervise the choice of raw material, extrusion process and final coil, each coil is born in our facilities with precision and passion.
This independence allows us to offer total control over the raw material, the process and the final result. We give you the best possible quality!

From Winkle we guarantee you a stable, homogeneous and quality certified under ISO 9001, which ensures the traceability and consistency of our processes. Choosing Winkle is not just buying filament, it is betting on a Spanish factory that innovates, produces and improves every day for you.
We refer to national and international levels. We produce 1000 tons a year with exhaustive control throughout the production chain.
We have the trust of thousands of suppliers, makers and professionals!
How to choose the filament for your 3D printer

Whatever your printer or level, the choice of filament will have a lot of weight in the final finish. In Winkle we explain what material to choose according to your objective: decorative finish, functional piece or technical production.
ASA: Professional performance.

The Winkle PLA is the most versatile and popular material in our catalogue. It will convince you by its impeccable finish, the rigorous thermal control that offers you and the moisture control that we apply during its manufacture. This ensures that each coil maintains a stable diameter and flow, reducing printing failures and improving interlayer adherence.
Users who print with Winkle notice the difference from the first layer:

If the PLA is the entry door for those who start, the Winkle PETG is the next step towards professional printing. This filament offers mechanical resistance, elasticity and shine. Qualities that make it the perfect choice for functional parts, technical prototypes or durable decorative elements.

Our PETG filament also provides high adhesion between layers and low moisture absorption, resulting in cleaner impressions, no bubbles or threads. Thanks to our cooling process we can control that Winkle PETG filament remains balanced and suitable for demanding environments.
Hydrophobic properties.

Designed for functional parts, housings, supports and industrial environments, it is compatible with any 3D printer without the need for closed camera. Each coil passes through diameter and traction controls to offer a warping-free impression or interruption.
The Winkle ASA is designed for those who print continuously and professionally. This filament.
